WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 13, 2026 / A Strategic Opportunity in a Changing Energy Landscape

Lithium remains an important material in the lithium-ion batteries used across electric vehicles and energy-storage applications. As manufacturers, policymakers and investors continue to focus on resilient supply chains, the development of reliable North American sources remains an important industry theme.

ELEKTROS Inc. (OTC PINK:ELEK), a publicly traded company on the OTC market, is evaluating a potential hard-rock lithium opportunity in northern New York, near the Canadian border on the American side. The opportunity remains exploratory. ELEKTROS has not announced a completed acquisition, independently verified mineral resource or reserve, or a determination that the property can be developed economically.

The Potential Advantage of a Domestic Location

A U.S.-based source of lithium, if supported by geology, property rights, permitting, infrastructure and commercially viable economics, could offer a more direct route to domestic processing customers. Depending on the project's eventual development pathway, domestic transportation could potentially reduce reliance on overseas ocean freight and certain international customs and import-related procedures.

These potential benefits have not been established for the property under review. A domestic location by itself does not establish mineral quality, project economics, permitting feasibility or commercial success.

Industry Demand Underscores the Importance of Supply

In an October 22, 2026 article titled "Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat," Benzinga reported a Benchmark Mineral Intelligence outlook that global lithium demand could more than triple by 2050, potentially requiring 134 new mines and more than $100 billion in investment. The article also discussed demand associated with electric vehicles and stationary battery storage.

Those figures are industry-wide estimates and are not forecasts for ELEKTROS or the northern New York opportunity. The Benzinga article discussed other companies, not ELEKTROS.

Lithium Interests and EV Charging Technology

In addition to evaluating lithium opportunities, ELEKTROS continues to explore potential development relationships involving its multi-port EV charging patent, U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1. The company views domestic lithium sourcing and EV charging innovation as separate but complementary areas of long-term interest.

No commercial charging prototype, licensing arrangement, customer adoption or patent-related revenue is being announced in this release.

The Milestones That Matter

The next meaningful steps in evaluating the northern New York opportunity include confirming property and mineral rights; obtaining independent geological assessment and sampling; reviewing environmental, land-use and permitting requirements; identifying realistic processing and transportation pathways; and evaluating potential financing needs and transaction terms.

ELEKTROS believes that a careful, evidence-based review is essential to determining whether the opportunity can progress beyond an early-stage concept. Any future decision would depend on the results of due diligence and the company's assessment of the associated risks, costs and potential benefits.

A Message to Shareholders

ELEKTROS appreciates the continued interest of its shareholders and those following the evolving North American lithium supply chain. The company intends to evaluate potential opportunities with ambition, discipline and respect for the technical, regulatory and financial work required to advance an early-stage project.

Management expresses gratitude to Almighty God as the company works toward measurable progress. This news release is provided for informational purposes only; it is not an offer to sell securities or a recommendation to purchase ELEK shares.

ELEKTROS Inc. is a publicly traded company on the OTC market under ticker symbol ELEK. Its areas of interest include hard-rock lithium opportunities, EV charging infrastructure and patented EV charging technology. The potential northern New York property discussed in this release has not been acquired by ELEKTROS and is not a producing mine.

17th annual benchmark from KeyBanc Capital Markets, formerly the SaaS Survey, expands to measure how AI is reshaping the private software industry

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KeyBanc Capital Markets Inc., the corporate and investment banking unit of KeyCorp (NYSE: KEY), today released results from its 17th annual AI x Software Benchmark, one of the longest-running benchmarks of financial and operating performance by software companies. Formerly known as the SaaS Survey, the benchmark has been expanded this year to examine how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing product strategy, monetization, unit economics, and operating models.

This year's findings show that companies selling AI as their primary product are growing significantly faster than their peers, but they also report weaker profitability and revenue productivity than software companies embedding AI into existing products. AI adoption is widespread; monetization and measurable financial impact remain early.

"For 17 years, this benchmark has given software operators and investors a clear view of how the industry is performing. This year, the central question is whether AI is creating a durable advantage," said Scott Peterson, Managing Director, Software Investment Banking at KeyBanc Capital Markets. " AI is accelerating growth and compressing development cycles, but AI spend is running ahead of budget and the economics are still catching up. 2026 is a proving year for AI-driven revenue."

"Developer headcount has historically been one of the biggest constraints for software development. AI coding tools are loosening that constraint as developer productivity improves," added Peterson. "But rather than let those gains drop to the bottom line, companies are reinvesting them to ship more product faster."

TOP TRENDS AND INSIGHTS:

AI-native companies lead on growth, while embedded AI leads on economics

  • Companies selling AI as their primary product reported median ARR growth of 34% in 2025, compared with 22% for companies embedding AI in broader products and 9% for companies still developing customer-facing AI.
  • Core AI product companies reported a median EBITDA margin of (12%) in 2025, compared with (1%) for embedded AI companies
  • Embedded AI companies also led on productivity, with ARR per FTE at $201K versus $117K for core AI product companies.
  • Companies that charge separately for AI products reported 27% median ARR growth in 2025, versus 17% for those that do not. That growth advantage has not yet translated into higher net retention.

AI revenue is small but poised to accelerate quickly

  • AI-driven ARR is projected to grow 128% in 2026, up from 74% in 2025, yet will still only represent 12% of total ARR.
  • Overall median ARR growth was 24% in 2025 and is projected at 23% in 2026, with participants planning for a broad-based acceleration to 40% in 2027.
  • Overall median EBITDA margin is expected to improve from (3%) in 2025 to 1% in 2026.

AI spend is outpacing budgets and showing up in margins before growth

  • More than four in 10 respondents (44%) report AI spend over budget year to date, and roughly a quarter (24%) are over by more than 20%. Higher-than-expected token usage was the most cited driver of variance.
  • Companies spending more than 5% of revenue on AI reported a median gross margin of 66% in 2025, compared with 78% for those spending less than 2%.

AI is speeding up product development, and workforce impact expected to broaden

  • 92% of respondents report that AI is shortening product development cycles, and 91% deploy AI internally in engineering.
  • 65% of participants report no AI-related headcount reduction or reallocation in 2025. Looking out 12 to 24 months, which falls to 34% with R&D (45%) and customer service (37%) the functions most likely to be affected.

Customers are building with AI, while autonomous agents remain early

  • 57% of respondents say their customers are building alternative products with AI coding tools.
  • Only 20% offer fully autonomous agents to their customers.

The 2026 AI x Software Benchmark is available for download at key.com.

Participation in Oracle Health Information Network will help clinicians access more complete health information and support coordinated care for Veterans, service members, and other beneficiaries

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle Health announced that the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and Department of War (DoW) began participating in Oracle Health Information Network, a designated Qualified Health Information Network® (QHIN™) under the Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement™ (TEFCA®) on November 5, 2026. By participating in Oracle Health Information Network, clinicians will have increased access to health information from participating healthcare organizations nationwide, improving care coordination and care for Veterans and service members.

Participation in Oracle Health Information Network will build on the existing Joint Health Information Exchange (JHIE) and give VA and DoW clinicians access to a broader range of patient information from participating community providers and other healthcare organizations. Over time, this may include additional information such as medical images, medications, and other data that may not be as readily available today. Clinicians can review and, when appropriate, reconcile that information into the patient chart using Oracle Health Seamless Exchange to limit duplicate information. This centralized and more complete view of a patient's health history supports better-informed care decisions, can help reduce unnecessary duplicate testing and clinical procedures, and enables more coordinated care for Veterans and service members.

VA and DoW serve millions of Veterans, service members, and other beneficiaries who receive care across federal and community healthcare settings. Through Oracle Health Information Network, VA and DoW will be able to securely exchange health information with organizations participating in TEFCA, extending their nationwide connectivity and helping make relevant health information available to clinicians as patients move across care settings.

Oracle Health Information Network provides a single connection point for secure information exchange across a broad range of healthcare organizations and use cases. This approach reduces the need to establish and maintain separate connections with individual organizations and provides a foundation for broader collaboration across care settings. As a designated QHIN, Oracle Health Information Network also enables nationwide exchange with organizations connected through TEFCA.

Oracle Health invites healthcare providers across the country to connect through Oracle Health Information Network to support the care of Veterans, service members, and beneficiaries. Broader participation can help clinicians across federal and community settings access the information they need to deliver more informed, coordinated care wherever these patients seek treatment.

"Delivering the best possible care for Veterans and civilian and military personnel starts with giving clinicians a comprehensive picture of their health," said Seema Verma, executive vice president and general manager, Oracle Health and Life Sciences. "We are honored to continue working with VA and DoW to advance their interoperability goals through Oracle Health Information Network, which gives clinicians timely access to critical health information wherever Veterans and DoW personnel receive care. This is another important step toward a connected healthcare system that puts patients first."

POMONA, CA, PROVO, UT, AND NASHVLLE, TN / ACCESS Newswire / November 13, 2026 / American Rebel Holdings, Inc. (OTCID:AREB), through American Rebel Light Beer - America's Patriotic Beer - is taking its "Win Hagan Win!" rally to the season finale as Matt Hagan pursues a historic fifth NHRA Funny Car world championship. With one event remaining, the four-time world champion and 2026 regular-season champion enters this weekend's In-N-Out Burger NHRA Finals at In-N-Out Burger Pomona Dragstrip with a 39-point lead over Jordan Vandergriff.

American Rebel first partnered with Hagan and Tony Stewart Racing (TSR) in August 2023, announcing a multiyear agreement that included selected primary sponsorships and associate support. That November, Hagan captured his fourth Funny Car world championship at Pomona. Now, that continuing relationship connects American Rebel Light Beer with his pursuit of number five.

"American Rebel joined the TSR family in 2023, the year Matt won his fourth world championship. Now we're behind him as he goes after number five," said Andy Ross, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of American Rebel Holdings, Inc. "Matt is a true American Rebel. He has earned this opportunity, and we're ready to cheer him on and raise a cold American Rebel Light Beer with fans who love racing and love the USA. Win Hagan Win! Win Rebel Win!"

Matt Hagan - Four World Titles. One Race Remaining. The Chase for Five.

A fifth world title would move Hagan ahead of Kenny Bernstein and Don Prudhomme into sole possession of second place on the all-time Funny Car championship list, behind only John Force.

Hagan's 2026 campaign includes four event victories and seven final-round appearances, highlighted by his 59th career Funny Car victory at Rockingham and a runner-up finish in Dallas. He returns to Pomona with eight event wins at the track, including three NHRA Finals victories and five Winternationals titles. In April, he defeated Ron Capps there to win NHRA's 1,000th Funny Car event.

"We're here, we're racing, and we've got a shot," Hagan said. "I think that's all you can really hope for: to just have a real shot at this championship."

A Season of Racing and National Brand Exposure for American Rebel

American Rebel's 2026 program combines selected primary sponsorships, associate branding, national television coverage, digital content and trackside fan engagement. The November 12-15 finale also brings a chance to cheer for Top Fuel standout Leah Pruett and toast TSR owner Tony Stewart's Robert E. Petersen Lifetime Achievement Award.

At Brainerd on August 23, Hagan drove the American Rebel Light Beer Dodge//SRT Hellcat Funny Car to victory and moved into the points lead. At Seattle on July 26, Pruett took the American Rebel Light Beer Top Fuel dragster to the final round, bringing the branded car into the closing showdown of a nationally televised event.

The scale of the opportunity was especially clear at October's Midwest Nationals, where Hagan reached the semifinals in the American Rebel Light Beer Funny Car. According to World Wide Technology Raceway, FOX's Sunday race telecast averaged 1.896 million viewers and peaked at 3.247 million, following a sold-out Saturday at the track. That weekend put American Rebel's primary-branded Funny Car into a major NHRA broadcast event with a national audience reaching into the millions.

Those moments give the Company a continuing story to share with adult consumers, distributors, retailers and hospitality accounts. American Rebel's objective is to turn recognition of its race-car branding into recognition of the beer itself - and give fans a reason to ask for American Rebel Light Beer wherever they gather to watch and celebrate.

"When Matt wins with American Rebel Light Beer on the car, or Leah takes our branded dragster to the final round, our beer becomes part of a moment fans remember," Ross added. "We have built this relationship over multiple seasons because the fit is real. Matt and Leah compete with conviction and live life on their own terms. That is the American Rebel attitude, and it belongs on our cans and in our brand."

Leah Pruett Is Ready to Finish the Job - Finish Leah Finish!

Pruett arrives at her home track following a runner-up finish in Las Vegas and a comeback season that included her 13th career Top Fuel victory at the New England Nationals - her first win since becoming a mother. Stewart's recognition adds another reason to celebrate ahead of Pomona. Hagan delivered TSR's first NHRA world championship in 2023; a fifth world title for Hagan this weekend would also give TSR its second.

Smith, NioCorp Executive Chairman and CEO. "Chairman Jovanovic and his team understand what it takes to bring projects of this scale into production, and we greatly appreciate their continued support. Our focus remains on completing the financing process and bringing this important source of American critical minerals into production as quickly as possible."

The feature includes a video highlighting EXIM Chairman and President John Jovanovic's October 14, 2026 visit to the Elk Creek Project, where he was joined by U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright, Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen, U.S. Senators Deb Fischer and Pete Ricketts, U.S. Representative Adrian Smith, Nebraska Senator Bob Hallstrom, other state and local leaders, and NioCorp leadership.

The Elk Creek Project is designed to produce niobium, scandium, titanium and several rare earth products from a single ore body in southeast Nebraska. PITTSBURGH--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Today, the Federal Home Loan Bank of Pittsburgh (FHLBank) joined Rebuilding Together Pittsburgh (RTP) alongside U.S. Rep. Summer Lee (D-PA-12), First Commonwealth Bank and stakeholders at a ribbon cutting for two Rehab for Resale (R4R) properties, located at 205 and 207 Rankin Blvd., as part of the Mon Valley Phase IV initiative.

In 2024-2025, FHLBank awarded nearly $5.7 million in Affordable Housing Program (AHP) and Voluntary Housing Grant (VHG) funding through its member financial institution, First Commonwealth Bank, to support RTP’s important rehabilitation efforts providing affordable homeownership opportunities throughout Mon Valley communities.

R4R Mon Valley Phase IV is an installment of a collaborative initiative between RTP, the Tri-COG Land Bank and First Commonwealth Bank to expand access to affordable homeownership in a region facing significant housing challenges.

“Increased access to quality, affordable housing is a core outcome of FHLBank’s dual mission,” said David G. Paulson, FHLBank president and CEO. “We are proud to support this initiative through multiple funding rounds of our Community Investment Products and are encouraged by the strong regional partnerships formed to not only preserve the existing housing supply, but also to create long-term wealth building opportunities and brighter futures for the families that will live here.”

The townhomes toured by event attendees today were two among six formerly vacant and blighted structures that Rebuilding Together Pittsburgh identified as opportunities to be restored into safe, healthy and affordable homes designated for buyers earning equal to or less than 80% of the area median income.

“We’re deeply grateful to FHLBank and our member bank, First Commonwealth Bank, for this partnership,” said Travis Renville, CEO, Rebuilding Together Pittsburgh. “Their support helps homeowners remain safely in the homes and communities they know and love, while allowing us to bring vacant homes back into use as safe, stable, and affordable places for new homeowners. By reducing blight, returning homes to the tax rolls, and welcoming new neighbors, this work helps strengthen communities in lasting ways.”

“We've got families across the Mon Valley who want to own a home, raise their kids, and build a future right here, but too often, the cost of housing puts that dream out of reach. Meanwhile, we've got vacant houses sitting in neighborhoods that deserve investment and a chance to thrive,” said Rep. Summer Lee. “I love seeing partners come together to give these homes new life and help working families build stability and generational wealth. I'm grateful to RTP, FHLBank, First Commonwealth Bank and everyone who helped make this happen, and I'm excited to see more of our neighbors get the opportunity to become homeowners.”

FHLBank Pittsburgh provides reliable funding and liquidity to its member financial institutions, which include commercial and savings banks, community development financial institutions, credit unions and insurance companies in Delaware, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / November 13, 2026 / A Strategic Opportunity in a Changing Energy Landscape

Lithium remains an important material in the lithium-ion batteries used across electric vehicles and energy-storage applications. As manufacturers, policymakers and investors continue to focus on resilient supply chains, the development of reliable North American sources remains an important industry theme.

ELEKTROS Inc. (OTC PINK:ELEK), a publicly traded company on the OTC market, is evaluating a potential hard-rock lithium opportunity in northern New York, near the Canadian border on the American side. The opportunity remains exploratory. ELEKTROS has not announced a completed acquisition, independently verified mineral resource or reserve, or a determination that the property can be developed economically.

The Potential Advantage of a Domestic Location

A U.S.-based source of lithium, if supported by geology, property rights, permitting, infrastructure and commercially viable economics, could offer a more direct route to domestic processing customers. Depending on the project's eventual development pathway, domestic transportation could potentially reduce reliance on overseas ocean freight and certain international customs and import-related procedures.

These potential benefits have not been established for the property under review. A domestic location by itself does not establish mineral quality, project economics, permitting feasibility or commercial success.

Industry Demand Underscores the Importance of Supply

In an October 22, 2026 article titled "Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat," Benzinga reported a Benchmark Mineral Intelligence outlook that global lithium demand could more than triple by 2050, potentially requiring 134 new mines and more than $100 billion in investment. The article also discussed demand associated with electric vehicles and stationary battery storage.

Those figures are industry-wide estimates and are not forecasts for ELEKTROS or the northern New York opportunity. The Benzinga article discussed other companies, not ELEKTROS.

Lithium Interests and EV Charging Technology

In addition to evaluating lithium opportunities, ELEKTROS continues to explore potential development relationships involving its multi-port EV charging patent, U.S. Patent No. 12,522,100 B1. The company views domestic lithium sourcing and EV charging innovation as separate but complementary areas of long-term interest.

No commercial charging prototype, licensing arrangement, customer adoption or patent-related revenue is being announced in this release.

The Milestones That Matter

The next meaningful steps in evaluating the northern New York opportunity include confirming property and mineral rights; obtaining independent geological assessment and sampling; reviewing environmental, land-use and permitting requirements; identifying realistic processing and transportation pathways; and evaluating potential financing needs and transaction terms.

ELEKTROS believes that a careful, evidence-based review is essential to determining whether the opportunity can progress beyond an early-stage concept. Any future decision would depend on the results of due diligence and the company's assessment of the associated risks, costs and potential benefits.

A Message to Shareholders

ELEKTROS appreciates the continued interest of its shareholders and those following the evolving North American lithium supply chain. The company intends to evaluate potential opportunities with ambition, discipline and respect for the technical, regulatory and financial work required to advance an early-stage project.

Report finds North American market rents average about 6% below the rent needed to justify new construction, as the global office pipeline falls 41% from its peak

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE: CWK), a leading global real estate services firm, today released Global Office Supply: The Development Drought, finding that North American market rents averaged $77.03 per square foot (psf) in 2026, about 6% below the economic rent, which is the minimum rent a new office development needs to earn to be profitable. The report projects that average market rents will not catch up until the early 2030s.

Globally, the under-construction office pipeline stood at 580 million square feet (msf) in Q3 2026, 45% below its 2017 peak and its lowest level in a decade. The report attributes the decline to “higher for longer” interest rates, sharply higher construction costs and an investor pivot away from the office sector. In North America, economic rents overtook market rents in 2023, when construction costs rose by double digits and borrowing costs began to climb.

“Demand for high-quality, well-located space is resurging just as the supply pipeline is drying up,” said Sandy Romero, Head of Office & Alternatives Insights at Cushman & Wakefield. “Average rents have not kept pace with the cost of building, so in most North American markets new supply will have to be built with the quality and amenities required to get leading rents in order to pencil out. Existing top-tier space is being absorbed faster than it can be replaced, which is driving rent growth in that segment, as well as more lease renewals and earlier occupier searches.”

New York is the clear outlier among the markets analyzed. Market rents of $156.64 psf in 2026 were nearly 60% above the economic rent of $98.69 psf, and New York has already begun to see construction tick up, with 6.4 msf underway as of Q3 2026, nearly double the level from a year ago. More than 2.5 msf of office space is under renovation as owners respond to the flight to quality.

Elsewhere, the viability gap varies. Chicago has the widest near-term gap among the U.S. markets analyzed, with 2026 market rents of $84.56 psf, 10% below the economic rent of $93.75 psf, and Class A vacancy of 24.0%. Boston market rents of $78.59 psf were 8% below economic rent, and the market currently has no projects under construction or renovation. San Francisco is close to the threshold, at 4% below economic rent ($98.43 psf versus $102.94 psf), with strong demand from AI occupiers expected to drive a recovery even as Class A vacancy remains high at 31.1%. Boston and San Francisco are both projected to reach viability in 2029, while Chicago is not projected to do so until 2032. Given the typical timeline to develop a new office building is three to five years, these thresholds are not as far out as they may initially seem.

In Canada, the report forecasts market and economic rents converging in Toronto around 2031, with no new development currently expected to commence before 2032. Downtown Class A and AAA vacancy stands at 10%, falling to 7.1% in the Financial Core. In Vancouver, which recently completed its largest office delivery cycle on record, roughly 3.8 msf across ten towers between 2020 and 2024, metro vacancy rose to 11.8% in Q3 2026, the highest rate since the early 2000s. The report forecasts economic rent will exceed market rent there through 2035.

“For occupiers, limited new supply means rising competition for top-tier space, so planning well ahead of lease events matters more than ever,” Romero said. “For investors and developers, new starts are likely to remain selective. In the meantime, we expect more renovations of existing buildings and more build-to-suit projects, particularly in markets where demand for brand new space is already building.”

The report also analyzes development viability across APAC and EMEA, using a consistent economic rent framework that accounts for land, construction, operating, leasing and financing costs and developer margin, and offers strategies for occupiers, investors, developers and owners.

For additional insights and analysis, read the full Global Office Supply: The Development Drought report.
